places-beffroi-de-l-hotel-de-ville-de-du.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-beffroi-de-l-hotel-de-ville-de-du.story: A 185 km round trip from Dunkerque - roughly 3 h 11 in the saddle. The stops in between: Beffroi de Gravelines, Beffroi de l’Hôtel de Ville de Calais, Beffroi de l’Hôtel de Ville de Boulogne and back through Beffroi de l’Hôtel de Ville de Calais. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
